name: StackGroupBanner
description: Dark live group-order banner for the Stack browse screen, showing deadline and joined teammates.
accessibility: Use as a button or link when it navigates to the group cart.
Do not convey order urgency only through color.

do: Use near the top of Browse when a group order is active.
Show joined member avatars as supporting context.
dont: Do not show when no group order is active.
Do not use for normal promotional banners.
